description: This file defines the SigmaTheme class which provides a static method to build a custom dark ThemeData for a Flutter app, including colors, text styles, and widget themes. It primarily focuses on theme configuration using color schemes and does not contain executable logic beyond theme setup.

classes.name: SigmaTheme
classes.description: Provides static methods to build custom theme data for the app, including color schemes and text styles.

methods.name: buildTheme
methods.description: Builds and returns a dark ThemeData object configured with neon accent colors, surface colors, and style themes based on provided hexadecimal color strings.

methods.name: _textTheme
methods.description: Generates a TextTheme object with styled text components based on the provided ColorScheme.
